result.final_text:
## What this letter says

Your blood test on 29 September 2026 showed a result of 52 mmol/mol for your HbA1c (a blood test showing average blood sugar over the last 2 to 3 months). This result is higher than normal. You might have type 2 diabetes. But we cannot be sure yet. You do not have any symptoms right now. So the doctor needs a second test to check if you have diabetes.

A diagnosis has not been made yet.

## What you need to do

1. Book a repeat blood test with the practice nurse within the next 2 weeks.
2. You do not need to fast for this test.
3. Book an appointment with Dr Thompson after the second test to discuss the result.
4. Do not start any new medicine for diabetes before you have spoken to the doctor.

## Dates and medicines

Blood test done: 29 September 2026
HbA1c result: 52 mmol/mol

No medicines are mentioned in this letter.

## Questions to ask your doctor

1. What does my HbA1c result mean?
2. What is type 2 diabetes?
3. What will happen at my appointment with Dr Thompson?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
